text: Proposal for the One-click card payments work: add one-click card payments to invoices. Invoices take 21 days to get paid on average; bank transfer is the only option.
My gut says average days until an invoice is paid is driven by something else, but I don't have data either way.
Fine by me as long as we can turn it off quickly.
